title: localfix: send application/mimi-protocol Content-Type
description: mimi-protocol PR #171 (2026-10-21) proposes application/mimi-protocol for TLS-encoded request/response bodies (not the JSON directory, not the proxyDownload response). mimid sends application/octet-stream (crates/mimid-server/src/http.rs:58 PROTOCOL_CONTENT_TYPE). Switch once #171 merges or the WG settles the name; regression test first. Mark: not today.
close_reason: PROTOCOL_CONTENT_TYPE = application/mimi-protocol (protocol-07 §4, §10.6) for protocol responses and PeerClient requests; directory stays application/json. Four existing Content-Type assertions moved to -07's type (9 failures on old constant). Receive side checks no Content-Type; unchanged, so pre-07 peers still work.
